'''Finolex Group''' is an Indian [[Conglomerate (company)|conglomerate]] [[company]] based in [[Pune]], [[India]].<ref>{{cite web |author=Site Search |url=http://www.finolex.com/index.aspx?idp=128&idc=164 |title=Finolex Cables |publisher=Finolex.com |date= |accessdate=2010-07-29 |archive-date=5 December 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101205013906/http://www.finolex.com/index.aspx?idp=128&idc=164 |url-status=dead }}</ref> The Finolex Group comprises Finolex Cables Ltd., Finolex Industries Ltd., Finolex J-Power Systems Ltd. and Finolex Plasson Industries Ltd. The group was founded in 1958 by P. P. Chhabria and K. P. Chhabria. The Finolex brand was intuitive from “Fine” and “Flexibles” and “O” with an electric arc across it – suggesting the electrical cable business the company was in. <ref>{{Cite web |title=In-Depth Marketing Strategy Of Finolex Industries - 2025 |url=https://iide.co/case-studies/marketing-strategy-of-finolex-industries/ |access-date=2025-03-15 |website=IIDE - The Digital School |language=en}}</ref>
